extraction_notes: Source PDF SHA-256 verified: fc3b5e7a906d10601e8cad07b271006c85710c422fd528a43fd99e9e9f739cea (C19271469__20N03.pdf, 7 pages, A4, Version 1.1). Identity: MPN 20N03, N-channel 30 V / 20 A / 15 mohm MOSFET, TO252-3L, device marking 20N03, ordering number HL20N03 (Halogen Free). Manufacturer: HL Microelectronics (named in the p. 7 disclaimer; site www.iseachip.cn). Public datasheet only; no vendor SPICE model or model pack was used.

Extraction method: scalar table values transcribed from the pdftotext layout of pp. 1-3; curve figures on p. 3 rasterized at 300 dpi with pdftoppm and digitized programmatically by pixel analysis, with data coordinates calibrated to the detected red gridline positions and, for log axes, the printed decade labels. Curve points are digitized_typical_curve grade; estimated reading accuracy about 2-5 percent (half a minor division), worse where traces bunch or cross as noted per curve.

Table-first policy: threshold (1.0/1.5/2.5 V), both RDS(on) rows (typ and max recorded as separate rdson_points entries), capacitances (490/79/61 pF at VDS = 15 V, recorded in SI farads), breakdown (30 V min) and body diode VSD (1.2 V max) all come from the p. 2 Electrical Characteristics table. Curves supplement: transfer (25/125 degC), output (2.5/3/3.5 V), RDS(on) vs ID (10/4.5 V), body diode forward (25 degC) and Ciss/Coss/Crss vs VDS. The digitized rdson and capacitance curves agree with the table typicals at the table bias points, which cross-validates the gridline calibration.

Figure 1 output characteristics: only the 2.5V, 3V and 3.5V traces were digitized. The 4V, 4.5V and 10V traces exit the 25 A plot top by VDS of about 1 V and bunch together near the origin, so they are not reliably separable and were omitted. Sub-1 V points of the 3.5V trace omitted for the same reason.

Figure 4 body diode: the 125 degC trace was not digitized; the two traces merge/cross near VSD 1.0 V, 100 A and the figure's y axis extends to 1000 A, far beyond the 38 A IDM rating, so only the 25 degC trace up to 100 A is recorded, as drawn.

Figures not digitized: Figure 5 gate charge (scalar Qg/Qgs/Qgd 10/1.7/2.5 nC at VDS = 15 V, VGS = 10 V, ID = 5.8 A are tabulated on p. 2; the schema has no gate-charge fields), Figures 7-8 normalized temperature-variation plots, Figure 9 SOA, Figure 10 ID vs TA derating, Figure 11 transient thermal impedance. p. 5 test circuits and p. 6 package drawing carry no electrical data.

Mild internal inconsistency recorded: the Figure 2 transfer curve (25 degC) reads about 2.5 A at VGS = 3.0 V, while the Figure 1 output 3V trace reads about 9.7 A at VDS = 3 V; noted on the output_characteristics_vgs_3p0V curve. Transfer-curve visible onset is near VGS 2.4-2.5 V, not in conflict with the 1.5 V typical threshold defined at ID = 250 uA, which is far below the plot's resolvable scale.

Other tabulated values without schema fields, noted here: IDSS max 1 uA at VDS = 30 V; IGSS max +/-100 nA at VGS = +/-20 V; switching times td(on)/tr/td(off)/tf typ 6/15/17/17 ns at VGS = 10 V, VDS = 15 V, RG = 3 ohm, ID = 3 A; IS max 9 A; trr typ 7 ns and Qrr typ 2 nC at IF = 5 A, dI/dt = 100 A/us; absolute maxima VDS 30 V, VGS +/-20 V, ID 20 A (TC = 25 degC) / 8 A (TC = 100 degC), IDM 38 A, EAS 28 mJ, IAS 13.8 A, PD 5.5 W, TJ/TSTG -55 to 175 degC; RthJC 36 degC/W, RthJA not published.
Page references use PDF page numbers, which match the printed footer numbering (1-7).
